checks.name: MCP API
checks.note: deep=1 also pings the database (Redis). Plain /health stayed green through the 2026-09-28 outage.

require.why: PRO accounts and sessions live in the same database

incidents.title: Sign-in to the MCP and PRO login unavailable
incidents.detail: Our database provider paused the database that holds sign-ins and sessions. Connecting the MCP, refreshing a session and logging in to PRO failed. Everything already in progress kept its data. Resolved by restoring the database; checks now test it directly every 5 minutes.

incidents.title: Brief slowdown: some MCP requests and sign-ins timed out
incidents.detail: Our database provider stopped responding for a few minutes. Requests that needed it waited and then failed, so some tool calls and session refreshes timed out. It recovered on its own; our 5-minute check caught it and alerted us within two minutes.
